detail.title: Multi-Unit Residential Property-Tanki Leendert 59E
detail.description:
Multi-Unit Residential Property (Three Apartments)

Located in the established residential area of Tanki Leendert, this dwelling at Tanki Leendert 59E is situated just off Watty Vos Boulevard, accessible via a dirt road. The property presents an attractive opportunity for investors or owner-occupiers seeking to acquire a multi-unit residential asset.

The property consists of one main dwelling subdivided into three (3) independent, semi-furnished apartments, each offering a functional and efficient layout. The dwelling is built on full ownership land measuring 985 m², providing long-term value and flexibility.

Location

From the property, Downtown Oranjestad can be reached in approximately 9 minutes, while San Nicolas is accessible in approximately 28 minutes, ensuring convenient connectivity to key areas of the island.

The surrounding area is a mixed residential and commercial zone and offers close proximity to essential amenities, including schools, supermarkets, hardware stores, restaurants, bars, and sports facilities.

detail.title: Spacious Family Retreat with Gazebo & Outdoor Living in Oranjestad
detail.description:
Spacious Family Retreat with Gazebo & Outdoor Living in Oranjestad!

Discover this inviting residence in the peaceful neighborhood in Oranjestad, Aruba. Situated on a generous 1,000 m² long lease lot, this home offers a total built-up area of 327 m², including a charming gazebo with outdoor bar and lounge—perfect for entertaining.

The main house features:

5 bedrooms including a master with private bathroom

3 bathrooms plus a guest restroom

Bright living and dining areas, with a spacious kitchen

An office room and a closed patio/living area

Convenient laundry and storage facilities

Outdoors, enjoy landscaped gardens with ornamental plants, palm trees, and fruit trees, along with multiple lounge areas and ample parking space.

With its combination of indoor comfort and outdoor leisure, this property is ideal for families seeking a serene lifestyle or investors looking for a versatile home in a well-connected location close to Oranjestad and Watty Vos Boulevard.

Interested in more information or want to schedule a viewing? Contact Jennifer Croes at +297 593 9811 or jennifer.croes@rogdutchcaribbean.com for more details!
